assumptions: Pooled OLS with conventional standard errors because Equation (1) does not report the estimator or covariance method.
Reported earnings are mapped to Compustat IB; the paper does not identify its raw earnings mnemonic.
Delta RDA is scaled by NOA at t+1; Table 9 omits the denominator year.
ARNOA uses adjusted NOA at t+1 following Table 8; appendix footnote 17 instead says NOA at t.

CRSP linked primary issue returns represent the sample firm’s stock return; company market equity is a complete sum of active common issues by PERMCO, and unavailable constituent values leave that company total missing.
CRSP share codes 10 and 11 are used as ordinary common shares; the paper does not name CRSP share codes.
Non-USD annual flows use Xpressfeed EXRAT12M cross-rates; balance-sheet values use EXRATD same-date GBP legs with a maximum seven-day prior quote when the statement date lacks a daily quote.
For benchmark formation year y, accounting rows are selected by actual DATADATE calendar year y-1; size uses prior December market equity and June y determines NYSE breakpoints.

At the initial investment date, target current size is company MVE at the end of month four after fiscal year-end; target current book-to-market is (CEQ + TXDITC + RDASSET) for that sample statement divided by MVE4, matched against the preceding June 30 cutoffs.

At each subsequent June 30 within the return window while the target remains listed, target current size uses June company market equity; target current book-to-market uses the latest annual statement whose assumed availability date (first day of the fifth month after DATADATE) has arrived by that June 30, divided by June market equity. The paper gives no release dates or exact refreshed B/M formula; this four-month publication-delay rule is an explicit timing approximation. If delisting occurs before June 30, no later target match is formed and the last available target group is carried for post-delisting returns.
After delisting, the benchmark group is the last target initial/June assignment available by the delisting month; the target is not reassigned after delisting.
TXDITC is used for the book adjustment because the paper says the deferred-tax term follows Fama-French (1993), though the paper’s wording is deferred tax liability.

limitations: The current local Compustat vintage does not establish the original PST/full-coverage/merged-research sample membership.
The source does not report Equation (1)’s regression N, estimator, standard-error method, t degrees of freedom, or sidedness.

For June 30 target reassignment, statement release dates are unavailable. The implementation applies a disclosed four-month publication-delay approximation and uses June-end company market equity; the exact refreshed book-to-market timing is not fully specified by the source.
Nonzero monetary values with no supported Xpressfeed conversion remain unavailable; pre-1982 non-USD annual flow coverage is limited by the local rate series.
Any active common issue with no attributable PERMCO is reported as an aggregate mapping limitation; candidate name-history PERMCO conflicts make the affected companies’ market equity unavailable.
